attempts.text:
The plan makes two trips to Dhunche temple, which together bring all 6 injured people to the shelter. Myagang care home can't be reached, so its elderly person is deferred.

- **Injured at Dhunche temple:** The car holds 4, so it needs two round trips of 26 minutes each, 52 minutes in total. Deferring 2 injured people instead would cost 160, far more than the extra 26 minutes of driving.
- **Elderly person at Myagang care home:** The only road to it, from Likhu market, is damaged, so no car can reach them. They are deferred at a penalty of 50.

Total cost is 52 driving minutes plus 50 for the deferral, which is 102.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 2
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 2
defer myagang-care-home elderly 1
</plan>

COST: 102
